specs.Configuration: Magic Note Pad with X3 Pro Pencil 2

features: ✅ [True Standalone Note Taking — No Phone/Laptop Needed]: The Magic Note Pad works completely on its own, so you can write, plan, annotate, and organise notes anytime—without needing to connect to a phone, tablet, or computer. Perfect for classes, meetings, and daily journaling when you just want to open and start writing instantly.

✅ [Paper-Like Display with AG Nano-Etched Glass] XPPen Magic Note Pad features a 10.95-inch anti-glare, nano-etched LCD with TCL NXTpaper 3.0 technology that reduces up to 95% ambient light interference. Enjoy a truly paper-like writing and reading experience with reduced reflections and enhanced clarity. Please Note: This is NOT an e-ink tablet; it is an Android LCD tablet designed to feel like paper.

✅ [3 Color Modes + X-Key Shortcut] Switch instantly between Monochrome LCD, Light Color, and Nature Color display modes using the X-Key. Ideal for note-taking, studying, PDF reading, journaling, planning, and sketching across different lighting environments.

✅ [World’s First 16K Pressure Sensitivity on a Note-Taking Tablet] Powered by the X3 Pro Smart Chip, the X3 Pro Pencil 2 delivers 16,384 levels of pressure sensitivity, a soft pen nib, ultra-fast response, and a customizable shortcut key. Perfect for handwritten notes, annotations, diagrams, formulas, and expressive pen strokes. Magnetic attachment keeps the stylus secure.

✅ [Smooth 90Hz Display + 16.7M Colors] Designed with a 90Hz refresh rate for ultra-smooth page turning and handwriting. Supports 16.7M colors and 400-nit brightness for a comfortable, vibrant viewing experience when reading or working on PDFs, slides, or documents.

✅ [Eye-Friendly TÜV Certified Display] Certified for Low Blue Light and Paper-Like Display by TÜV SÜD. Reduces flicker and filters up to 75% harmful blue light, making the Magic Note Pad ideal for long study sessions, reading, note-taking, and office work.

✅ [Android 14 Tablet with 128GB Storage + Fast Charging] Runs on Android 14, allowing you to download apps from Google Play for study, productivity, and entertainment. Equipped with 128GB storage, an 8000mAh battery, and 20W fast charging. For best performance, avoid running too many apps at once.

✅ [Built for Online Classes & Remote Meetings] Features a 13MP front camera, dual microphones, and dual speakers—perfect for online learning, Google Meet/Zoom calls, remote work, and presentations. Lightweight at 495g and only 7mm thick for maximum portability.

✅ [Optimized Viewing Angle for True Paper Feel] The etched-glass LCD uses a deliberate narrow viewing angle to reduce glare, diffuse reflections, and light scatter. For the clearest and most paper-like experience, view the tablet directly from the front.

✅ [Perfect for Students, Teachers & Professionals] Ideal for handwritten notes, digital planning, studying, note-taking alternatives to reMarkable or Kindle Scribe, PDF reading, sketching, journaling, and productivity workflows. Great for students, teachers, designers, office users, and anyone who prefers handwriting over typing.
